_header.date: 2026-10-30 (round 1); 2026-11-01 (round 2: the not_measured items, cases mover_ctrl, mover_cels, mover_cels_ctrl, mover_cels_b, sel_shift_cel_depois_arrasto, esc_*, reverse_picks*, clear_cels_*, paste_new_sprite_rgb)
_header.app: Aseprite Trial 1.3.18.6-x64-trial (AppImage), observed black box, never source
_header.where: own Xvfb :78 1600x1000x24, isolated HOME, SDL_VIDEODRIVER=x11; never the owner's screen
_header.input: tl.ase written by docs/PixelArt/ferramentas/trial_timeline.py gera (public .ase spec): 16x16 RGBA, 6 frames, durations_ms [100,200,300,400,500,600], frame colours red,green,yellow,blue,orange,purple (index 0..5) on layer A (bottom, flags 3 = NOT continuous), layer B (top, flags 3|16 = continuous) with cels only on frames 1 and 3, tag 'walk' frames 2..4 (file stores 1..3 base 0)
_header.command: python3 -I docs/PixelArt/ferramentas/trial_timeline.py caso <dir> <case>   (gestures in CASOS; same case names below)
_header.reading: the Trial cannot save: durations read from the status bar after clicking each frame header ('<n> <ms>ms/<total>s'); frame identity = layer-A colour at the canvas centre; timeline state and dialogs from screenshots

fields.frames / range / result: 1-based frame numbers as the Trial shows them
fields.durations_ms: duration of frames 1..N after the gesture
fields.order: original frame index (0-based, = colour index) found at each position after the gesture
fields.undo_steps: Ctrl+Z presses that restored the original state

_header.round_2_layout: timeline splitter dragged from y=741 to y=778 so the round-1 screen map holds (headers y=826, B 850, A 874); dk:<x0,y0,x1,y1> = the d drag with Ctrl pressed only before the release

constant_frame_rate.opens: the Frame Properties dialog (no immediate change)
constant_frame_rate.prefill_rule: duration of frame 1 of the sprite (prefill 700 with frame1=700, frame5=50, active frame 4)
constant_frame_rate.scope: ALL frames of the sprite, also when a range 3..5 is selected (dialog still says [1...6])

contiguous.prefill_rule: first frame of the range (not min, not active)

frame_properties_range.rule: OK writes the typed duration to every selected frame and only to them; differing durations are not flagged, the field shows the first selected frame's value

tag.open: double-click on the tag label; right-click on the label = menu [Tag Properties..., Delete Tag]

from2_to99.rule: to clamped to the last frame; reopened dialog shows To 6

tag.delete_frames_covering_tag: Delete Frame on 2..4 (the whole tag) removes the tag; one Ctrl+Z restores frames and tag

continuous.where: 3rd icon column of the layer row in the timeline: two dots = discontinuous, bar = continuous; one click toggles. The header icon of that column showed a bar once all layers were continuous (not clicked)
continuous.toggle_undo_evidence: Shift+N, toggle the new layer, one Ctrl+Z -> the new layer is gone

new_frame_alt_n.continuous_layer: new cel LINKED to the previous cel
new_frame_alt_n.discontinuous_layer: new cel is an independent copy
new_frame_alt_n.after_toggling_A_continuous: A also gets a linked cel

selection.shift_click_header: ADDS that single frame (picks, not a span): click 2 + Shift-click 4 = {2,4}, 3 NOT selected (confirmed by Frame Properties 'Multiple Frames' and Delete Frame)
selection.ctrl_click_header: adds the frame: click 1 + Ctrl 4 = {1,4}; + Ctrl 6 = {1,4,6}
selection.ctrl_click_selected_or_inside_box: no change, no toggle-off (Ctrl 4 again keeps {1,4}; Ctrl 2 inside the bounding box of {1,4,6} adds nothing)
selection.drag_cels: rectangle layers x frames (B2 -> A4 = B..A x 2..4)
selection.click_layer_name: the whole layer row becomes the range
selection.esc: clears the range; active frame/cel stays
selection.outline: a yellow box is drawn around the bounding box of the selection, also for picks
selection.shift_click_after_drag: drag headers 2..3 then Shift-click 5 = {2,3,5} ('Multiple Frames'), 4 NOT selected: Shift never fills a span
selection.shift_click_cel: click A1 + Shift-click A3: headers 1 and 3 highlighted, 2 not (picks, same rule as headers; read from the header highlight only)

shift_click_cel_after_drag.result: cel picks: frames {2,3,5} (4 not highlighted), layer A; Frame Properties says 'Multiple Frames'
shift_click_cel_after_drag.other_layer: drag A2..A3 then Shift-click B5: layers B..A, frames {2,3,5}

esc_with_mask_and_range.esc_1: clears the range AND the mask (marching ants gone)

select_all_clears_range.result: the range box is gone at once; the mask is there; one Esc then deselects

reverse_alt_i.disabled_when: a single frame is selected (menu item greyed)

link_cels.where: right-click on the cel range -> [Cel Properties..., Delete, Unlink, Link Cels, Duplicate Cel(s) Alt+D, Duplicate Linked Cel(s) Alt+M]

clear_delete_key.undo_restores: A2..A4 back; a 2nd Ctrl+Z changes nothing visible in the timeline

two_layers.result: B1, B3, A1..A3 removed, frames kept

move_range.how: drag the range OUTLINE (yellow box edge); dragging from a header starts a new range instead
move_range.rule: frames move with their durations and cels; the moved block stays selected (4..5)

move_range_ctrl.drop: boundary between frames 5 and 6, Ctrl pressed before release
move_range_ctrl.rule: copies of the frames (durations and cels, B cel of frame 3 copied too) are inserted at the boundary; the originals stay; the copies become the range (6..7); tag 'walk' 2..4 unchanged

move_cels.result: A5 = old A2, A6 = old A3 (old A5, A6 overwritten), A2 and A3 empty; frames and durations unchanged [100..600]; the range follows to A5..A6
move_cels.rule: a cel range moves its cels by the columns/rows the pointer travelled, over what is there; frames never move

move_cels_ctrl.drop: as move_cels, Ctrl pressed before release
move_cels_ctrl.result: A5 = copy of A2, A6 = copy of A3, A2 and A3 kept; durations unchanged; range A5..A6

move_cels_other_layer.drop: row A, column 3 (pointer travelled 1 row down, 2 columns right)
move_cels_other_layer.result: A3 = old B1 (A3 overwritten), B1 empty, B3 kept; the range follows to A3

reverse_picks.rule: picked (non-contiguous) frames reverse their ENVELOPE first..last, the unpicked frames in between included

not_measured: click on the header continuous icon (all layers)
Paste as New Sprite itself (greyed under Xvfb; the sibling New Sprite From Selection was measured, see born_sprite_palette)
whether a Ctrl-copied frame block links cels on continuous layers (copies are taken as independent)
dropping a cel range so it would leave the grid (we clamp the travel to the grid) or onto a group row (we refuse)
Shift-click on a cel over 3+ layers (rectangle vs set of layers)

born_sprite_palette.case: paste_new_sprite_rgb (+ manual retry on the same screen)
born_sprite_palette.paste_as_new_sprite: Edit > Paste Special > Paste as New Sprite stays GREYED in the Trial under Xvfb even after Ctrl+C (Paste itself is enabled): not runnable here
born_sprite_palette.measured_on: Edit > New Sprite From Selection (Ctrl+Alt+N) with Ctrl+A on tl.ase (RGBA, palette of 8 entries)
born_sprite_palette.result: the new RGBA sprite 'tl-0x0-16x16' carries the SOURCE palette (the same 8 swatches); a File > New RGBA sprite carries the default 32-colour palette
born_sprite_palette.rule: a sprite born from a piece of another carries that one's palette in every colour mode, RGBA included
